<documents>
<document id="fee-refunds">
AskingˆforˆaˆfeeˆrefundˆSupportˆcanˆrefundˆsomeˆfees.ˆThereˆareˆtwoˆkindsˆofˆrefund.ˆ##ˆFeesˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆIfˆweˆchargedˆaˆfeeˆyourˆplanˆdoesn'tˆhave,ˆorˆchargedˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆweˆrefundˆit.ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆtheseˆrefundsˆandˆtheyˆdon'tˆcountˆtowardˆanythingˆelse.ˆ##ˆGoodwillˆrefundsˆOnceˆinˆanyˆrollingˆ12-monthˆperiod,ˆsupportˆcanˆrefundˆoneˆfeeˆofˆupˆtoˆ$25.00ˆasˆaˆcourtesy,ˆevenˆifˆitˆwasˆchargedˆcorrectly.ˆThatˆcoversˆATMˆfees,ˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees,ˆcardˆreplacementˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆfees,ˆwireˆfeesˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfees.ˆPlanˆfeesˆaren'tˆeligibleˆforˆgoodwillˆrefunds.ˆTheyˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆcooling-offˆruleˆinstead.ˆ##ˆWhatˆsupportˆcan'tˆdoˆSupportˆcan'tˆrefundˆaˆsecondˆfeeˆasˆgoodwillˆwithinˆ12ˆmonths,ˆcan'tˆrefundˆaˆsingleˆfeeˆaboveˆ$25.00ˆasˆgoodwill,ˆandˆcan'tˆmakeˆexceptionsˆtoˆtheseˆrules.ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆaˆfeeˆwasˆchargedˆinˆerror,ˆtellˆusˆwhyˆandˆwe'llˆcheck.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆaskˆOpenˆtheˆfeeˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆtapˆGetˆhelp,ˆandˆchooseˆQuestionˆaboutˆaˆfee.ˆRefundsˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆbalanceˆrightˆaway.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
ChargedˆtwiceˆforˆtheˆsameˆthingˆSeeingˆtheˆsameˆchargeˆtwiceˆdoesn'tˆalwaysˆmeanˆyouˆwereˆchargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆCheckˆifˆoneˆisˆpendingˆHotels,ˆgasˆstations,ˆcarˆrentalsˆandˆrestaurantsˆoftenˆplaceˆaˆtemporaryˆauthorization,ˆthenˆpostˆtheˆfinalˆamountˆseparately.ˆTheˆpendingˆoneˆusuallyˆdropsˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ##ˆIfˆbothˆhaveˆpostedˆIfˆtwoˆidenticalˆchargesˆhaveˆbothˆposted,ˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirst.ˆMostˆwillˆrefundˆaˆduplicateˆquickly.ˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆdoesn'tˆhelp,ˆdisputeˆtheˆsecondˆchargeˆinˆtheˆappˆasˆaˆduplicate.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆChargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆDuplicateˆfeesˆIfˆweˆchargedˆyouˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆAˆfeeˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆisˆalwaysˆrefunded.ˆ##ˆTimeˆlimitˆDuplicateˆchargesˆfollowˆtheˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwindow:ˆ120ˆdaysˆfromˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆ##ˆSplitˆpaymentsˆSomeˆmerchantsˆsplitˆoneˆorderˆintoˆseveralˆcharges,ˆforˆexampleˆwhenˆitemsˆshipˆseparately.ˆCheckˆyourˆorderˆconfirmationˆbeforeˆyouˆdispute.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-plus-v2">
PlusˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆPlusˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ1%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$35.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆYourˆfirstˆ3ˆout-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆeachˆcalendarˆmonthˆareˆfree.ˆTheˆfeeˆappliesˆfromˆtheˆnextˆone.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Can support refund my monthly Plus fee as a one time courtesy thing?
